Kernel Semantic.source: packages/ui/src/styles.css :root/.dark shadcn theme block; + alpha-baked semantic/ring-50, semantic/destructive-20 (rings) and semantic/destructive-10 (destructive button fill, light 10% / dark 20% per code); + semantic/primary-80, secondary-hover, destructive-hover (button hover states)

Kernel Primitives.source: packages/ui/src/styles.css raw scales (brand/neutral/status/viz/commodity) + light/base/dark and status/* aliases

Kernel Metrics.source: radius/{sm,md,lg,xl,full}, control heights (decision 0010), motion durations (decision 0018), spacing/* 4px grid (decision 0064), border/*, fontSize/*, lineHeight/*, ease/* reference strings

effectStyles.note: 10 elevation effect styles: elevation/{light,dark}/{sm,md,lg,xl,2xl} — from the styles.css shadow ramp (--shadow-sm..2xl). Figma has no shadow variable type and effect styles can't mode-switch, so light/dark are separate style trees; 2xs/xs omitted (transparent by design). --shadow == --shadow-sm in code so no separate 'shadow' style.

textStyles.note: 18 local text styles: text/{2xs,xs,sm,base,lg}/{regular,medium}, text/{xl,2xl,3xl}/{regular,semibold}, mono/{sm,xs}. Sans stand-in: Inter (code uses system-ui stack); mono stand-in: Roboto Mono. Sizes = Tailwind scale + custom text-2xs (11/16) from styles.css.

Tokens.note: Reference swatch sheets; every swatch fill / metric bar is bound to a variable. All 333+ variables carry scopes and (where a stable CSS var exists) WEB code syntax.

component.button.note: Mirrors @kernel/ui buttonVariants incl. interaction states (96 variants; icon sizes omitted). Hover fills: primary-80 / muted / secondary-hover (premixed color-mix) / muted / destructive-hover (alpha-baked 20/30) / link underline. Focus: 1px semantic/ring border + 3px spread drop-shadow bound semantic/ring-50 with showShadowBehindNode:false (translucent fills otherwise muddy). Disabled: node opacity 0.5 (node-level, safe from bind-drops-opacity). Mirrors @kernel/ui buttonVariants (icon sizes omitted). Heights bound to control-h vars, colors bound to semantic vars, destructive fill bound to alpha-baked semantic/destructive-10 at paint opacity 1 (see GUIDE hardened gotchas). Radius bound to radius/lg (radius/md for xs/sm), paddings/gaps bound to spacing vars per size, sm label 12.8px (text-[0.8rem]). Rebuilt 2026-09-19 after file-side deletion; built directly inside its section. Dark preview frame 10:500 (instances + explicitVariableModes) kept in section.

component.input.note: Code Input has no cva variants; State axis models pseudo-class styling. Height control-h, radius radius/lg, px spacing/2-5, py spacing/1, border semantic/input|ring|destructive, rings = 3px spread drop-shadows bound to semantic/ring-50 / semantic/destructive-20, disabled = 50% opacity + input/50 fill. Placeholder text/sm/regular on semantic/muted-foreground.

menu-button-set.note: Icon slot is a 16px nested MDI instance wired to the Icon instance-swap property; icon vectors colored to match the label per state.

component.sidebar.note: Composed of nested instances; widths 256 (16rem) / icon 48 (3rem); heights bound spacing/8|7|12 equivalents; colors semantic/sidebar-* Icons: barley (switcher), view-dashboard/file-document/truck/cash-multiple/chart-box/cog (rows, outline where available), account-circle-outline (footer).

object.workspace.note: App shell exploration — icon rail + top bar + left/canvas/right panels. Grids token-bound (spacing/2); fills not yet variable-bound. Second copy at 4:7.

Material Design Icons.note: Published MDI library, enabled in this file. Mirrors the code's ./icon MDI shim (prefer *-outline). Import via importComponentByKeyAsync; hangs if the library isn't enabled in Assets.
